question: What takes place in the world of Satya?
premises: The self-born Brahma abides in Satya and manifests this universe.
The Vedas and others are present in Satya.
They are cultivated there through ritual action and meditation.
inference: Satya is the realm where Brahma manifests the universe and where Vedic realization is perfected through action and meditation.
plain_english: There the self-born Brahma abides and manifests this universe. In Satya the Vedas and others are cultivated through ritual action and meditation.
